text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winter has arrived, and with it, a variety
of
different festivities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some throw extravagant parties, some
celebrate
in a more subdued manner,
and some...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sizzle!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait. It's much too early to start
cooking
the meat. We have to make a
toast first.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Does everyone have a glass? All
right—all
together now!

text_block_list.name: Boxing Students
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute's family home doubles as
a boxing
gym that her father runs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They've rented the parking lot of the
convenience
store next door to hold a
barbecue with all the
boxing students.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Anyone in need of a refill? I'm pouring.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, everyone. No eating the meat
raw,
understood? Also...

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student 1
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Miss Acute. You don't have
to play
hostess the whole time. Let your
hair down and
have some fun.

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student 2
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. We're celebrating your racing

achievements today too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: That is nice of you to say, but...

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student 1
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Trainer! Thanks for always
being there
to guide Miss Acute!

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student 2
text_block_list.text:
And it's amazing how you're like her
cornerman at
the racecourse. You know
just how to get her
pumped up.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer doesn't even realize how
important
that skillful guidance has been
in my
development.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. I'm really very
grateful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we're talking, I hear the sound of fists

pounding against mitts coming from the
gym.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thwap, thwap! Thwap!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Are some people training instead of
joining
the festivities?

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student 1
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Some of us have bouts coming up,
so
they're cutting weight.

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student 1
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's working extra hard. We can't
let you
hog all the glory, now can we?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see... How admirable.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Still, even if they're not eating, they can
have a
drink at least.
Let's see, where
are the glasses? Glass, glass...
Grass...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Grass?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hello, Acute.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm shocked to see Grass Wonder
standing before
us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She used to live in the US, but she's a
traditional
Japanese beauty... albeit one
with a warrior's
heart. But what is she
doing here?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I guess the smell of all this delicious
meat was
too much to resist. Go ahead
and grab a pl—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I don't need any food. Actually...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thwap, thwap! Thwap!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to take in that sound instead.
Isn't it just
lovely? Nothing says true
elegance like the sound
of a fighting
spirit thirsting for victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sound of punching mitts is...
elegant? I don't
get it, but I suppose
Grass Wonder has her own
unique
aesthetics.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little surprised by the variation in
sound...
Perhaps it's because you have a
variety of
different people training here.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Each student's punches resonate
differently.
Some are packed with
youthful zeal, while others
ring with
accomplishment.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. We have all sorts here,
from
amateurs yet to have their debut
bout to
seasoned veterans.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Those getting ready to hang up their
gloves don't
pack the same punch they
used to...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Is that so? If you ask me...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The ferocity of burgeoning buds does
carry a
certain appeal...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But so too do the fallen leaves who fight
against
their fate, dreaming of being
lush and green once
more.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...I do. Even if their punches sound short
on
strength, I sense no surrender in
them.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
What I sense is the will to forge onward
in search
of victory. ...And I feel it rather
profoundly.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
This is a wonderful place. Just standing
here is
like a breath of fresh air that
reinvigorates my
spirit.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's like each punch is another beat in
the poem
heralding these mighty
warriors.

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student 1
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Sounds like you really get it, Grass
Wonder!

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student 2
text_block_list.text:
Here, have a cup of juice! You should
stay and
kick back for a while!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how kind of you. I might just take
you up on
that. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But is it really okay for me to crash your
party,
Acute?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Of course, dearie. Good girls like you
are more
than welcome.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to drop by whenever you want.
Consider
today fate.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Why, thank you. I've taken a rather
strong liking
to this place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A poem for warriors. They don't simply
struggle
on. Rather, they dream of the
day they can bloom
once again...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I savor the words, taking them as an
unexpected
gift.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: What is it, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I'm right there with you.
choice_data_list_en: ...Let's keep at it. We've still got a long way to go.
...Let's keep at it. We still have a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Jingle, jingle, jingle...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Many consider this time of year to be
romantic,
but the jingling bells I hear
don't ring out for all
the lovers out
there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They're for all those who refuse to give
up on
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They're for all those who refuse to give
up on
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later that night, we go for a walk to see
a display
of holiday lights.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... It's hard to relax among all this
glitz and
glam...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm seeing spots...
Oh, and what's that?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Would you look at that. They're beautiful and easy on the eyes.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Go on, take a gander. Aren't they
lovely?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's looking at a storefront selling cute
silver
jewelry and decorations. There are
all sorts of
holiday-themed pieces on
display, like wreaths
and stockings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not only are they adorable, they're also

reasonably priced. I pick out something
Wonder
Acute might like.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Goodness gracious... Trainer, you
shouldn't
have...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I give her an impromptu holiday gift and

apologize that it isn't more extravagant.

However...
choice_data_list: ハッピーホリデー、アキュート！

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, don't be so silly.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's the thought that makes me happy.
I'm glad
you're thinking of me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'll keep it as a memento of
our time
together today.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... But I really do like keepsakes
like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Keepsakes... Mementos of special
times...
Suddenly, an idea hits me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: You want to give me more silver?
choice_data_list: 大きなレースを勝つたびに贈ろうか？
choice_data_list_en: Shall I give you one every time you win a big race?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer...
choice_data_list: ああ、思い出になるから
うん、思い出になるから
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, it'll make a great memory.
Yeah, it'll make a great memory.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You're such a kind soul. Yes... If it isn't a
bother,
then I would like that very
much...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'll need to work extra hard to collect as
many of
these exquisite pieces as I can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a small promise, but Wonder Acute
seems
overjoyed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From now on, her collection of silver
pieces will
grow each time she wins a
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us vow to create a grand
collection of
memories that we can look
back on with pride
one day.
